assumptions.choice: EMA(5) computed on close price via bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=5)
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'EMA(5)' without naming a source line; close is the standard/default basis for EMA.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss offsets (the 3R formula) are computed from the actual filled entry price (order.executed.price) after the entry stop order completes, not from the theoretical setup_high/setup_low trigger price.
assumptions.reason: The spec's formula names 'entry' as a value, most literally the realized fill price; this is only knowable once the order completes.

assumptions.choice: Entry order size is computed at setup time as (0.05*equity)/(setup_high-setup_low), using the pre-committed stop-order trigger prices rather than the not-yet-known actual entry price.
assumptions.reason: Order size must be fixed when the stop entry order is submitted, before the fill price is known; setup_high-setup_low is the only distance available at that time.

assumptions.choice: While an entry stop order is pending, a new setup candle in the same direction is ignored; only an opposite-direction setup triggers cancellation and replacement.
assumptions.reason: Spec only states cancellation on an opposite setup and is silent on same-direction re-setups.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit are two independent Stop/Limit orders submitted on entry fill, manually managed as one-cancels-other in notify_order, rather than backtrader's buy_bracket/sell_bracket helper.
assumptions.reason: Bracket helpers require child prices fixed when the parent (entry) order is submitted, before the fill price needed for the 3R target is known.

assumptions.choice: Computed size is used as-is (float shares), not rounded to an integer.
assumptions.reason: Spec gives an explicit sizing formula with no mention of rounding; backtrader's default broker accepts fractional sizes.

assumptions.choice: If a would-be setup candle has setup_high == setup_low, no entry order is placed for it.
assumptions.reason: The sizing formula divides by stop_distance; a zero-range candle would cause a division by zero, an edge case the spec does not address.
